spec_case: issue #403: on_error does not reach an over-limit CEL expression any more
description: The explicit nesting limit is checked when the document compiles, before any effect runs -- so an over-limit expression fails the whole document the same way a syntax error would, and the `gate_paren` effect's own `on_error: continue` never gets a chance to run: the document never starts, `marker` never runs, and there is no `meta.error` to catch. A per-shape failure like this one used to happen during evaluation instead, where `on_error: continue` could catch it and let the run finish; this case proves the compile-time failure holds on both engines.
